objective: A difference does not fail the step by default; it asks for a person
preconditions: a baseline, and a page that has visibly changed
input: The same change with the default policy and with onDifference "fail"
expected: The default run passes its step with a "differs" verdict recorded, and the run configured to fail does fail — most visual differences are intentional, and a check that fails the build on every redesign is one a team switches off
detail: default: run passed, verdict differs; onDifference=fail: run failed, verdict differs
